description: Source code for AES encryption driver for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) module in the Linux kernel, supporting multiple AES modes including ECB, CBC, CTR, and RFC3686, with platform-specific includes and crypto algorithm registration.

methods.name: aes_set_key
methods.description: Sets the AES encryption key in the context, supporting 128, 192, and 256-bit keys.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes
methods.description: Main interface to AES hardware for encryption/decryption in various modes.

methods.name: ctr_rfc3686_aes_set_key
methods.description: Sets the RFC3686 mode key and nonce.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes_ecb
methods.description: Configures AES hardware to ECB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes_cbc
methods.description: Configures AES hardware to CBC mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes_ofb
methods.description: Configures AES hardware to OFB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes_cfb
methods.description: Configures AES hardware to CFB mode.

methods.name: ifx_deu_aes_ctr
methods.description: Configures AES hardware to CTR mode.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_aes
methods.description: Initializes the AES driver and registers algorithms.
